Rooms.Name: The Treasury
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small but well equipped treasury. You can see some
writing on the wall. The ceiling has a funny glow, which enables you to
see. You can get back into the inner lair through the stone door which
is east.

Exits.Description: You look back through the opening into the inner lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a heavy black stone door it looks very solid.
You read the number '666'.

Rooms.Name: The inner Lair
Rooms.Description:
You are in a octagonal room with smooth purple stone walls. The
floor is made from black stone. In the western wall you see a large
black stone door.

Exits.Description: You look back through the door into the lair.
You see the treasury.

Rooms.Name: The Lair
Rooms.Description:
On the floor you see a lot of human decay, like bones and skulls.
You also see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its
sconce. To the north are a wooden door.

Exits.Description: You can see the inner lair.
You see another part of the lair.
You see another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On all the skulls you notice that there is a three inch hole in the
forehead.  All the bones are broken and old.
The slime is slimy and uninteresting.
The torch is bolted to the sconce and the sconce to the wall.

Rooms.Description:

You also see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its

Exits.Description: You see another part of the lair.
You see another part of the lair.

You also see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its
sconce.

Rooms.Name: The lair entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dry part of the sewer. To the north is a wooden door,
you can see some slime at the lower part of the door. You also see some
skulls and some broken bones.

Exits.Description: You can see the lair.
You see a crawlway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The slime is slimy and uninteresting.

Rooms.Name: The crawlway
Rooms.Description: You are in a narrow crawlway. Here is very boring.

Exits.Description: You see a four-way junction.
You see the entrance to a lair.

Rooms.Name: The four-way function
Rooms.Description:
You are in a sewer junction. To the north is a small hole, to the
west is a narrow crawlway and to the east and south the sewer
continues.

Exits.Description: You can see a small cave-like room.
You can see a sewer drain.
You can see a sewer drain.
You can see a narrow crawlway.

Rooms.Name: The small cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a collapsed sewer drain, which now is more like a small
cave.

Exits.Description: You look back into the four-way junction.

Rooms.Name: The sewer drain
Rooms.Description: You are in a dry sewer drain which bends to the north.

Exits.Description: You can see the drain continuing north.
You can see the four-way junction.

Rooms.Name: The sewer drain
Rooms.Description: You are in a dry sewer drain which bends to the east.

Exits.Description: You can see the drain continuing east.
You can see the drain continuing south.

Rooms.Name: The drain end
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the drain around you the sewer has collapsed,
the only exit is west.

Exits.Description: You see the sewer drain.

Rooms.Name: The half-wet drain
Rooms.Description:
You are in a sewer drain where the floor is covered with water. To
the north it looks more dry, south however the drain runs down into
some water.

Exits.Description: To the north lies a dry four-way junction.
To the south you see a sewer drain filled with water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The water is dirty but it looks like you would be able to swim in it.

Rooms.Name: Under water in the sewer
Rooms.Description:
You swim in some dirty water and is holding you breath. You'll
better continue before you drown. It is a good thing that you can hold
your light above water-level.

Exits.Description: It is hard to see, but it looks like the drain runs slightly upwards.

It is hard to see, but it looks like the drain runs a little bit
upwards.

Rooms.Name: The half-dry drain
Rooms.Description:
You are in a half-dry sewer drain. To the north the drain runs a
little bit downwards into some water to the east you can see a small
hole. To the west you see another drain.

Exits.Description: You see the drain running down into some water.
Through the hole you can just make out a very small room.
You see a drain running to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The water is dirty but it looks like you would be able to swim in it.
Through the hole you can just make out a very small room.

Rooms.Name: The very small room
Rooms.Description: You are in a very small room, it is pretty uninteresting.

Exits.Description: Through the little hole you can see a half-dry drain.

Rooms.Name: A dry sewer drain
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dry but dirty sewer drain. The drain continues east and
south.

Exits.Description: You see a half-dry drain.
You see another boring sewer drain.

Rooms.Name: A boring drain
Rooms.Description: You are in yet another sewer drain.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer drain continuing to the north.
You can see another drain to the east.

Rooms.Name: The sewer drain
Rooms.Description:
You are in a sewer drain, there is nothing special inhere, except
for a loud echo.

Exits.Description: You can see another sewer drain.
You can make out a sewer drain to the west.
You can see a sewer line.

Rooms.Name: The sewer drain
Rooms.Description: You are in a drain, with some slimy water on the floor.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer bend.
You see a sewer drain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The water floats to the east from here.

Rooms.Name: The sewer bend
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in an ordinary sewer bend, which bend from west to
north.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer drain.
You see a sewer drain.

Rooms.Name: The sewer junction
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a junction of three sewer drains. You see some odd
scratches on the pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat. North and south the
sewer continues as usual, but west it looks a little strange.

Exits.Description: You see nothing but a sewer drain.
You see nothing but a sewer drain.
You see a strange sewer pipe.

Rooms.Name: The sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are in a sewer, where the slimy water runs down through a tiny
hole. You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as from a gigantic
rat. There is a sewer drain south.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer drain.

Rooms.Name: The strange sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are in a very strange sewer indeed, there are some odd scratches
on the pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat. And you can see a lot of
organic decay like bones from animals AND humans. West the drain runs
slightly upwards.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer junction.
You see a slimy sewer drain.

Rooms.Name: The damp sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are in a sewer drain with a funny damp substance on the floor,
in the substance you see a lot of decay. You see some odd scratches on
the wall, as from a gigantic rat. Both to the east and west the pipe
seems to run down.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer.
You see a sewer.

Rooms.Name: The strange sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are in an ordinary sewer except for a lot of scratches on the
sewer wall, ad a lot of debris on the floor.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer.
You see another sewer.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a lot of organic decay on the floor.

Rooms.Name: The sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are in a sewer with more scratches on the walls. And of course a
whole lot of decay. The drain runs east and north.

Exits.Description: You see yet another sewer line.
You see a sewer pipe.

Rooms.Name: The sewer drain
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a sewer drain, you are able to see some kind of
cave-like room. You see some odd scratches on the drain wall, as from a
gigantic rat. The sewer leads south.

Exits.Description: You see a cave-like room.
You see a sewer.

Rooms.Name: The rat's lair
Rooms.Description:
You are in a little cave. You are able to see quite a lot of debris
on the floor. There is a sewer drain west of here.

Exits.Description: You see the sewer system that way.

Rooms.Name: The Wall of the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You hang onto some steps leading down into utter darkness. There's
an exit leading up as well, though you'll have to open the tiny rock
again to do so.

Rooms.Name: The entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are in a very dark room. You notice that some faces are staring
at you from inside the walls. In the middle of the room there is a
small altar. To the north there is a small round door.

Exits.Description: A beam of red light seeps through a hole in the door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This altar are very special.  Faces are smiling from it.  There
is a triangle in top of it.

The triangle are filled with small symbols.  A language you have
never seen before.

Rooms.Name: The corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is glowing oppressively in a red hue. You can hear
wailing through an open black hole to the east. To the south there is a
round door.

Exits.Description:
The hole seems more black than the night. It is appears to be "eating"
the red light around it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door is completely round without a keyhole.
The red light glows from the walls.
The walls look alive.

Rooms.Name: The Realm of lost souls
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in nothing. All around you there are stars.
Sometimes a shadow flies closely by you, wailing very loudly. To the
north there is a small bright hole. To the west there is a small red
hole.

Exits.Description: You look into a very bright hole.
You look into a red hole.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The shadow looks like a man in great pain.

Rooms.Name: The T-crossing
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small hallway. There are doors to the east and to the
west. To the south there are a black hole. There is writing in the
wall. Wails can be heard from the south.

Exits.Description: A black hole in the wall.

You can see a big fire to the west. It looks like a unhealthy place to
enter!
To dark to tell.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The writing says 'The one to the east, belongs to the beast.
To the west you will surely END your quest!'.

Rooms.Name: The firedeath
Rooms.Description:
This room is very hot. There are flames surrounding you. You can see
no exits at all! Skeletons are lying all over the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skeletons looks like they had suffered the death of hunger.
One of them looks like he has written something at the wall.

The writing says 'A pray to the GODS will not be heard, though
the only exit is death.....  Mother, I love you'.

Rooms.Name: The Torture Room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a middle of a square room. Along the walls
skeletons are hanging in rusty chains. In the middle of the room there
is a big metal box, covered with dust. To the south you can just make
out a small exit.

Exits.Description: To dark to tell.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you look at the skeletons, you can see that they once had been in
great pain.  They are hanging in their arms, and some of them has been
killed with a sharp instrument.

The metal box is covered with dust.  You notice that is once has been
filled with coal, as you see some of them.

Rooms.Name: The hells yard
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. A disgusting smell surrounds the
place, and makes you fell sick. Small flames sometimes shoot up from
the hot mud. To the west there is a small door. To the north you can
see an iron door.

Exits.Description: To dark to tell.
To dark to tell.

Rooms.Name: On the walls of the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are clutching the steps on the wall so that you don't fall to
the ground down below. A large sign says : I haven't gotten any further
... Yet. But I'm pushing to get finished with this sewer. Greetings and
Good Health :) Redferne The Gentle This stops your journey down, the
only exit is up.

Mobs.Name: mud monster mudmonster
Mobs.LongDescription: A horrifying Mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud...
Mobs.Description:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie.  It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human 
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner
- Perhaps you?

Mobs.Name: rat
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge hungry-looking sewer rat sits here.

Mobs.Name: master mindflayer
Mobs.LongDescription: The master mindflayer is here, looking at you with an evil look.
Mobs.Description:
It's a seven foot tall humanoid dressed in a purple cloak, and swinging a
black and purple rod above its head as if it was going to attack you any
moment now.  In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.

Mobs.Name: senior mind mindflayer
Mobs.LongDescription: The senior mindflayer walks around here, looking for something useful.
Mobs.Description:
This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high.  Dressed in purple and black,
and carrying a large mace in its hand.  In the center of its head are four
large tentacles with very sharp points.

Mobs.Name: junior mind mindflayer
Mobs.LongDescription: The junior mindflayer is here, watching you carefully from the corner.
Mobs.Description:
This mindflayer is six feet high.  It has a small mace in its belt, and is
dressed in purple and black cloth.  It has four small tentacles in the center
of its head.

Mobs.Name: wererat rat were
Mobs.LongDescription: An ugly wererat is here, looking at you with a strange flick in his eyes.
Mobs.Description:
The wererat is about four feet tall.  It looks very much like rat, except
that it is standing.

Mobs.Name: rat gigantic
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a gigantic rat here, looking at you with a hungry look.
Mobs.Description:
The gigantic rat is about ten feet long from head to tail and has claws the
size of your head, looking very nasty.

Objects.Name: ring silver
Objects.Description: A lovely silver ring has been left here.

Objects.Name: rod devil
Objects.Description: The mysterious devil rod lies on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is indeed a mysterious rod.  It is dark black at the base but has four
very sharp purple tentacles at the end.

The mace is pretty large with a weight of 10 lbs.  The head is actually four
purple tentacles tied together.

Objects.Name: mace small
Objects.Description: a small mace has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This weapon does look like it does a lot of damage, but then you never know.
It consists of a black handle and a purple head.

Objects.Name: cloak purple
Objects.Description: A purple cloak lies on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a very fine made cloak from an unknown material, in a nice purple
color.

Objects.Name: potion blue
Objects.Description: A neon blue potion stands on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: In the flask is a transparent electric blue liquid.

Objects.Name: key black
Objects.Description: A black key has been left on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This little key is made from a black metal of unknown origin.

Objects.Name: skull white
Objects.Description: A strange white skull lies on the floor looking at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skull has two small horns in the forehead. You notice some writing on
the inside.
You read the number '666'.

The small stick does not look interesting at all.  But just as you are going
to throw it away you notice some small letters.
It reads 'Hold me'.

Objects.Name: boots muddy
Objects.Description: A pair of muddy boots has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The boots are muddy and they look well worn, but also very comfortable.

Objects.Name: treasure coins
Objects.Description: There is a huge treasure here, looking very valuable.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This looks like a whole lot of coins.

Objects.Name: sword short
Objects.Description: A short sword is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a very nice little weapon.
